body:
## Summary
- Fix statements the code has outgrown: past conversations reopen from the sidebar, a failed model call is a 503 with a stored apology (not a 500), the agent has three tools including `export_conversation_pdf`, and `users` has `clerk_user_id`.
- Refresh the test counts (178 API, 69 UI), drop the notes on a greeting-name test the UI no longer has, and add the sidebar and `reply-ui` tests.
- Add a known gap: an exported PDF is written to `medas-api/exports/` and nothing serves it.
- Update `CLAUDE.md` to match: tools, `AgentUnavailable` → 503, `patient.py`, PII masking and verify, rate limits.
- Crop the three json-render screenshots so they no longer show the old stethoscope header icon (regenerating them needs a signed-in app and billable model calls).

The evaluation results are left as they are: a dated run, with the question, case and index counts re-checked against the files.

## Test plan
- [x] `prettier --check` on `README.md` and `CLAUDE.md`
- [x] Test counts taken from fresh `pytest` and `vitest` runs
- [ ] Skim the cropped screenshots in the rendered README
